title: The Cloud upon the Sanctuary
subtitle: Translated by Isabel de Steiger, with an Introduction by Arthur Edward Waite
author: Karl von Eckartshausen
imprint: Third issue, revised and enlarged. London: William Rider & Son, 1909
edition: Third issue, revised and enlarged, Rider, 1909
note: The third issue, of 1909, revised and enlarged, with Waite's introduction: set from the sacred-texts.com transcription of it, the Letters read word by word against the translation's first printing in The Unknown World (1895). The transcription's slips are corrected; the print's own misprints are kept, and the 1909 revision's wording where it differs from 1895.
